items.statement: The two normalized surface moments evaluate the selected numerator. \(f\in L^1(\sigma),\qquad\int f\,d\sigma=-\frac{s-1}{n(1-r^2)}.\) Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including equality. No parity restriction is imposed; \(n/2\) is real even when n is odd. The selected parameters imply \(s\ge2\), \(0<r<1\), \(\ell>0\) and \(1-r^2>0\). These domain facts and every needed L1/measure identity are proved inside existing canonical dependencies, never supplied as extra assumptions. All expectations are actual real Bochner integrals. Absolute integrability is a conclusion. Standard totalized division/rpow off the measure support changes none of the asserted integrals. \(\sigma\) is the actual normalized ambient surface law defined below. The A1 input is used only in the unambiguous source range \(n\ge3\). \(\begin{aligned}s&=\sqrt\kappa,&r&=\left(1-\frac1n\right)\frac{s-1}{s+1},\\\ell&=\frac{4ns+(s-1)^2}{8n(n-1)},&v&=\frac{(-1)^n}{n}\left(\frac{s-1}{s+1}\right)^n\frac{(1-1/n)^{n/2}}{1-r^2}.\end{aligned}\) \(\tau=\mathrm{vol}.\mathrm{toSphere},\quad\sigma=\tau(S^{n-1})^{-1}\iota_*\tau,\quad U(y)=y_1,\quad D(y)=1+r^2-2rU(y),\quad f(y)=\frac{(s+1)U(y)-(s-1)}{D(y)^{n/2}}.\)

items.statement: The actual Gaussian and density expectations have the same exact value. \(H_\gamma=H_p=\frac{(-1)^n}{n}\left(\frac{\sqrt\kappa-1}{\sqrt\kappa+1}\right)^n\frac{(1-1/n)^{n/2}}{1-r^2}.\) Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including equality. These domain facts and every needed L1/measure identity are proved inside existing canonical dependencies, never supplied as extra assumptions. All expectations are actual real Bochner integrals. Absolute integrability is a conclusion. Standard totalized division/rpow off the measure support changes none of the asserted integrals. Both outer integrands \(O\mapsto\det(O)\int t\,d\gamma_O\) and \(O\mapsto\det(O)\int t p_O\,dx\) are in \(L^1(\mu)\). These facts, the density identity and positive definiteness are internally supplied conclusions, not extra binders. \(\begin{aligned}s&=\sqrt\kappa,&r&=\left(1-\frac1n\right)\frac{s-1}{s+1},\\\ell&=\frac{4ns+(s-1)^2}{8n(n-1)},&v&=\frac{(-1)^n}{n}\left(\frac{s-1}{s+1}\right)^n\frac{(1-1/n)^{n/2}}{1-r^2}.\end{aligned}\) \(\begin{aligned}A_O&=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top),&\gamma_O&=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1}),\\p_O(x)&=\frac{\sqrt{\det A_O}}{(2\pi)^{n/2}}e^{-x^\top A_Ox/2},&t(x)&=e^{-\ell\|x\|_2^2},\\H_\gamma&=\int\det(O)\!\left(\int t\,d\gamma_O\right)d\mu,&H_p&=\int\det(O)\!\left(\int t(x)p_O(x)\,dx\right)d\mu.\end{aligned}\) \(\tau=\mathrm{vol}.\mathrm{toSphere},\quad\sigma=\tau(S^{n-1})^{-1}\iota_*\tau,\quad U(y)=y_1,\quad D(y)=1+r^2-2rU(y),\quad f(y)=\frac{(s+1)U(y)-(s-1)}{D(y)^{n/2}}.\)
